english.title: Attempt common assault
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) attempted to assault **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 39 of the Criminal Justice Act 1988 and section 1(1) of the Criminal Attempts Act 1981.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
This is a summary offence and an 'attempt' would not generally be possible. Due to the provisions of section 40 of the Criminal Justice Act 1988, common assault may be included in an indictment if the charge arises from the same facts or is of a similar character. This may enable the use of the 'attempt' code.
This offence, should not, however, be charged in any other circumstances - it would be for the court to decide whether such a prosecution was appropriate.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant attempted to assault **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..).
